usage.outputShape: body.price, body.change, body.changePercent, body.open, body.high, body.low, body.previousClose, body.marketCap, body.name, body.industry, body.exchange, body.currency, body.timestamp (flat JSON object)
usage.guide: Call GET https://finance.toonhaus.dev/api/stock/quote with a required query parameter `ticker` set to a stock symbol (e.g. ticker=AAPL). Pay $0.001 USDC via x402 on Base. The response is a flat JSON object with the live quote: read body.price for the current price plus body.change/body.changePercent for the day move, and body.name/body.industry/body.exchange/body.marketCap for company info. Plain synchronous call, no auth or polling needed.
